Readout

What it measures

Evidence, not a magic “fix.”

01

Correlation

Pearson-style left/right similarity from −1 to +1, measured in short windows across the track.

02

Mono retention

Compares stereo energy with a mono fold-down to reveal destructive cancellation.

03

Risk map

Shows when correlation turns negative so you can inspect the actual arrangement or mix decision.

A negative reading is a diagnostic signal, not an automatic artistic verdict. Always confirm against your monitoring, mono reference and musical intent.

Built by TwinphaseX for musicians, mixers and audio-tool developers. Free to inspect, test and improve.
